title: THE ITEM WHEEL
why: His order of 2026-10-14: "add a wheel for heals and grenades. You go to the wheel, you select one." Holding Q now opens a wheel in the middle of the screen with one segment for each kind of item you carry: frag, smoke, decoy, tripwire, bandage, medkit, stim and armour plate, each with its picture, its name and how many you have. The game keeps running while it is open, so you can still move but you cannot fire. Move the mouse toward a segment and let go of Q to pick it; let go with the mouse in the middle and nothing happens. The pick is measured from where the mouse was when you opened the wheel, so a quick tap never picks something by accident. In this first step a pick chooses what G throws and what H heals with (a plate slots at once); the next steps put the item in your hand and use it on the trigger. Melee moved to V, so the crowbar swings on V now; both keys can be changed in the key screen.
now: Hold Q for the item wheel: aim at a grenade or a heal and let go to pick it. Melee is on V now.
